item.title: Eminem’s Ex-Wife Kim Mathers Pleads No Contest to Driving While Impaired in Michigan Hit & Run
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our daily update. We've got some news from the world of entertainment. Eminem's former wife, Kim Mathers, has been involved in a criminal case in Michigan. Let's dive into the details."
[Short music transition]
Host: "On Monday, May 11th, Kim Mathers pleaded no contest to two misdemeanor charges related to a car accident that occurred on February 16th. According to prosecutors, Mathers was driving a white Range Rover when she hit a parked silver Dodge Ram, pushing it over 50 feet. The problem is, she didn't report the crash afterwards."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Mathers was charged with Operating – Impaired and Failure to Stop After Collision. By pleading no contest, she accepts the conviction without admitting guilt. Her sentencing is set for June 17th, where she could face up to 93 days in jail for the impaired operating count and up to 90 days for the failure to stop charge."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The Macomb County Prosecutor, Pete Lucido, had some strong words about the case, saying 'Driving under the influence is not a lapse in judgment — it is a deliberate decision that puts every person on the road at risk.' Kim Mathers was married to Eminem, whose real name is Marshall Mathers, from 1999 to 2001 and again in 2006. They share a 30-year-old daughter, Hailie Jade Scott, and Eminem also adopted his and Mathers' niece, Alaina Marie Scott."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's the latest from the world of entertainment. We'll keep you updated on this story as more information becomes available. Thanks for tuning in!"
